theorem: The section cocycle of the frozen clock extension GL(2,3)->S4 is computed on all 24^2 pairs and verified on all 24^3 cocycle triples. Adding the parity cup-square epsilon(sigma)epsilon(tau) produces a second central extension with one involution and the binary-octahedral 2^-S4 order spectrum, whereas the original has the GL(2,3)=2^+S4 spectrum with 13 involutions. The difference is the coboundary of b(sigma)=i^epsilon(sigma) after enlarging coefficients from mu2 to mu4, so the two nonisomorphic double covers define equivalent complex projective cocycles with that determinant-phase gauge. On the clock's projective C4, the two missing Pass10954 C8 characters k=2,6 are exactly the two mu4 characters taking the clock generator to +i and -i and squaring to permutation sign.
